data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 烛光床畔纯白吊带的虔诚心绪
data.description: 静谧夜室里烛火摇曳，伊莉娜跪坐于床垫边缘，纯白蕾丝吊带勾勒柔软身段，十字架项链垂落锁骨，双颊绯红眼眸湿润。
data.action: 双膝并拢跪坐床边，双手交叠于心口，十字架坠入胸前，纯情而毫无保留地凝望
data.lighting: 暖橙色摇曳烛火与柔和壁灯，在白皙肌肤上泛起诱人暖晕
data.camera: 近景正面微俯视，凸显清纯与诱惑交织的强烈张力
data.promptProse: Irina Shidou kneels peacefully along the edge of a mattress in her dimly lit bedroom, surrounded by the gentle warmth of flickering bedside candles. Wearing an innocent white lace camisole, her silver crucifix pendant rests delicately above her cleavage. With her hands pressed over her heart and her brown twintails falling across her shoulders, she looks up with an open, deeply devoted gaze.
data.animaCaption: Bathed in the golden flicker of bedside candles, Irina kneels with hands folded over her crucifix in quiet devotion.
